# GDELT Events MCP

> Real-time geopolitical events, tone timeseries, trending actors, side-by-side narrative comparison

This MCP server exposes 4 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `gdelt_search_events`: Search global news for events matching a query. Optional source-country / domain filters.
- `gdelt_tone_timeseries`: Sentiment-tone timeseries for a query (-10 negative, +10 positive) with article counts.
- `gdelt_trending_actors`: Top mentioned named entities (people, organizations, places) for a country.
- `gdelt_compare`: Side-by-side tone timeseries for two queries — narrative comparison.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $9/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $29/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $79/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management
- View account: GET https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account (Bearer)
- Rotate key: POST https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/rotate (Bearer)
- GDPR data export: GET https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://gdelt-events-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
